json_format: sorted keys, 1-space indent, ensure_ascii, trailing newline
number_format: floats rounded to 9 significant digits (printf %.9g) then written as the shortest round-trip decimal; S_t, tolerance, margin_t and ref_top1_logit are each rounded independently from the full-precision value; the checker uses the tolerance field
pass_rule: On every gated step of all five prompts, fifi's teacher-forced argmax must equal reference_token, and |fifi logit for reference_token - ref_top1_logit| must be at most tolerance (2 * S_t). Excluded steps are not graded. Top-5 set agreement and the log-sum-exp difference are reported per step, not gated.
rule: REPLY-40 items 1-3 as frozen by REPLY-41. S_t is the largest pairwise difference of the top-1 logit at step t among the three frozen references (llama.cpp CPU -t 12, CPU -t 6, and the CUDA build), all teacher-forced on the CPU -t 12 greedy stream, with a floor of 0.05; the top-1 logit of each reference is its logit for the CPU -t 12 top-1 token. Gated step: all three references agree on the top-1 token at step t, and the CPU -t 12 top-1 margin at t is greater than 2 S_t. Excluded steps are not graded.
